//===== NEED Phase 0.12 - item display name bulk rollout PoC ================
//= TEST ONLY. Loaded only by conf/import/need_lang_test/map_a.conf and
//= map_verify.conf - never by conf/map_athena.conf.
//=
//= GENERATED by p12_build_verifier.py from phase12_runtime_samples.csv.
//= 32 sample ids covering the eleven characteristics of request section 12,
//= printed through the eight server-side output paths, so one KR screenshot
//= and one EN screenshot answer sections 13 and 14.
//============================================================================

lasagna,177,140,4	script	NEED Phase12 ItemName Bulk	4_F_KAFRA1,{
	mes "[Phase 0.12 Item Display Name - bulk rollout]";
	mes "getneedlang() = " + getneedlang() + "   (0 = KR, 1 = EN)";
	mes "rolled out : 21,713 SAFE ids.  samples below : " + getarraysize(.Poc);
	next;
	switch (select("1. getitemname (all samples):2. mes + sprintf:3. dynamic select:4. dispbottom:5. mesitemlink / mesitemicon:6. getequipname:7. lookup regression (needs items):Close")) {
	case 1: callsub S_Plain; break;
	case 2: callsub S_Mes; break;
	case 3: callsub S_Menu; break;
	case 4: callsub S_Bottom; break;
	case 5: callsub S_Link; break;
	case 6: callsub S_Equip; break;
	case 7: callsub S_Lookup; break;
	}
	close;

S_Plain:
	mes "[1] getitemname(<id>)  - page 1/4";
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < getarraysize(.Poc); .@i++) {
		if (.@i > 0 && .@i % 8 == 0) { next; mes "[1] getitemname(<id>)  - page " + (.@i / 8 + 1) + "/4"; }
		mes .Poc[.@i] + " : " + getitemname(.Poc[.@i]);
	}
	return;

S_Mes:
	mes "[2] mes + getitemname()";
	mes "You need " + getitemname(6919) + " x600 and " + getitemname(399905) + " x30.";
	mes "Reward : " + getitemname(9530) + " / " + getitemname(420576);
	next;
	mes "[3] sprintf + getitemname()";
	mes sprintf("%s : %d held, %d needed", getitemname(900106), countitem(900106), 30);
	mes sprintf("%s -> %s", getitemname(12654), getitemname(12685));
	next;
	mes "[long names - 45 to 49 bytes, the truncation edge]";
	mes "10625 : " + getitemname(10625);
	mes "12523 : " + getitemname(12523);
	mes "16506 : " + getitemname(16506);
	mes "16509 : " + getitemname(16509);
	next;
	mes "[two ids that share one English name - display text, not a key]";
	mes "562 : " + getitemname(562);
	mes "563 : " + getitemname(563);
	mes "^FF0000Both must read the same. They are still two different items -^000000";
	mes "^FF0000check that with menu 7.^000000";
	return;

S_Menu:
	mes "[4] a select() string built from getitemname()";
	mes "The option count and order must be identical in both clients.";
	next;
	.@m$ = "";
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < 8; .@i++)
		.@m$ += getitemname(.Poc[.@i]) + ":";
	.@m$ += "Back";
	.@s = select(.@m$);
	if (.@s <= 8)
		mes "You picked option " + .@s + " : " + getitemname(.Poc[.@s - 1]);
	else
		mes "You picked option " + .@s + " : Back";
	return;

S_Bottom:
	mes "[5] dispbottom - look at the chat window";
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < getarraysize(.Poc); .@i++)
		dispbottom "[P12] " + .Poc[.@i] + " = " + getitemname(.Poc[.@i]);
	return;

S_Link:
	mes "[6] mesitemlink() - the label is server text";
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < 8; .@i++)
		mes .Poc[.@i] + " : " + mesitemlink(.Poc[.@i]);
	next;
	mes "[6b] mesitemicon() - icon on, so the name is not sent;";
	mes "with feature.mesitemicon off it falls back to the display name.";
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < 4; .@i++)
		mes .Poc[.@i] + " : " + mesitemicon(.Poc[.@i]) + " " + getitemname(.Poc[.@i]);
	next;
	mes "[6c] itemlink() - <ITEML>, carries no name at all.";
	mes "English in an EN client with or without this Phase.";
	mes "6919 : " + itemlink(6919);
	mes "9530 : " + itemlink(9530);
	return;

S_Equip:
	mes "[7] getequipname(<slot>) - what you are wearing";
	mes "Head top    : " + getequipname(EQI_HEAD_TOP);
	mes "Armor       : " + getequipname(EQI_ARMOR);
	mes "Right hand  : " + getequipname(EQI_HAND_R);
	mes "Garment     : " + getequipname(EQI_GARMENT);
	mes "Costume top : " + getequipname(EQI_COSTUME_HEAD_TOP);
	return;

S_Lookup:
	mes "[8] lookup regression - the Korean name must still be the KEY.";
	mes "This gives you 1 of each of 4 items by their ^0055FFKorean^000000 name,";
	mes "then removes them again. Nothing else is touched.";
	next;
	if (select("Run it:Cancel") == 2) return;
	.@bad = 0;
	.@before = countitem(500); getitem "초코 강정", 1;
	if (countitem(500) != .@before + 1) { .@bad++; mes "^FF0000FAIL^000000 getitem ^0055FF초코 강정^000000 did not add 500"; }
	else mes "ok  getitem ^0055FF초코 강정^000000 -> id 500 (" + getitemname(500) + ")";
	delitem 500, 1;
	if (countitem(500) != .@before) { .@bad++; mes "^FF0000FAIL^000000 delitem 500"; }
	.@before = countitem(501); getitem "빨간포션", 1;
	if (countitem(501) != .@before + 1) { .@bad++; mes "^FF0000FAIL^000000 getitem ^0055FF빨간포션^000000 did not add 501"; }
	else mes "ok  getitem ^0055FF빨간포션^000000 -> id 501 (" + getitemname(501) + ")";
	delitem 501, 1;
	if (countitem(501) != .@before) { .@bad++; mes "^FF0000FAIL^000000 delitem 501"; }
	.@before = countitem(512); getitem "사과", 1;
	if (countitem(512) != .@before + 1) { .@bad++; mes "^FF0000FAIL^000000 getitem ^0055FF사과^000000 did not add 512"; }
	else mes "ok  getitem ^0055FF사과^000000 -> id 512 (" + getitemname(512) + ")";
	delitem 512, 1;
	if (countitem(512) != .@before) { .@bad++; mes "^FF0000FAIL^000000 delitem 512"; }
	.@before = countitem(513); getitem "바나나", 1;
	if (countitem(513) != .@before + 1) { .@bad++; mes "^FF0000FAIL^000000 getitem ^0055FF바나나^000000 did not add 513"; }
	else mes "ok  getitem ^0055FF바나나^000000 -> id 513 (" + getitemname(513) + ")";
	delitem 513, 1;
	if (countitem(513) != .@before) { .@bad++; mes "^FF0000FAIL^000000 delitem 513"; }
	next;
	mes "[8b] the two ids that share one English name are still separate items";
	.@b562 = countitem(562); .@b563 = countitem(563);
	getitem 562, 1;
	if (countitem(562) == .@b562 + 1 && countitem(563) == .@b563)
		mes "ok  562 went up, 563 did not - " + getitemname(562) + " is display text only";
	else { .@bad++; mes "^FF0000FAIL^000000 562/563 are being confused"; }
	delitem 562, 1;
	next;
	if (.@bad == 0) mes "^0055FFAll lookup checks passed.^000000";
	else mes "^FF0000" + .@bad + " lookup checks FAILED - stop and report.^000000";
	return;

OnInit:
	// phase12_runtime_samples.csv, ascending item id
	setarray .Poc[0], 500, 501, 512, 513, 514, 562, 563, 572;
	setarray .Poc[8], 590, 622, 638, 642, 741, 1093, 1101, 1102;
	setarray .Poc[16], 6919, 7720, 9530, 10625, 12523, 12654, 12673, 12685;
	setarray .Poc[24], 16506, 16509, 19649, 19692, 20990, 399905, 420576, 900106;
	end;
}
